'''Halfback's Bluff''' was a popular game on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Pantolomin/Legends|Pantolomin]]. Popular among casual [[Gambler/Legends|gamblers]] it was played by travelers aboard the ''[[Coral Vanda]]'',<ref name="EGVV" /> or from any other [[Boat/Legends|ship]] of in shallow waters near a [[Casino/Legends|casino]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|9|Halfbacks Bluff}}</ref> The game involved releasing a colorful object into the [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]] whenever the cruise liner encountered a school of [[Pantolomin halfback]]s. Bets were placed on which halfback would then take that trinket back to their lair.<ref name="EGVV" /> If the creatures wrestled amongst themselves without any of them taking the trinket for over ten [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]], then the bets were canceled and all money collected by the house. Because of this, corrupt casinos and criminal organizations began to rig the game by ensuring that the halfbacks were unable to find the trinket.<ref name="CSWE" />
